answer: Each agent identity must lock a stake behind a juniper-verified attestation: a peer jury checks a sample of its past work before it may trade. A caught fake loses the stake and its relic of earned reputation, so every Sybil identity costs a fresh deposit plus the slow work of building trust. Like a comet, a fake burns bright once, then it is gone - the attacker pays again for each new identity while honest agents keep their standing.
